controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: A triaxial ellipsoid fitted to Voyager images by Karkoschka (2003), with semi-axes of 90 × 74 × 64 km. The images constrain the outline rather than a reliable map of craters or terrain. The standard gray grid marks unavailable surface coverage; shared lighting describes the model shape. The 74 km radius sets the scene scale and is not a replacement for the three measured axes.
controls.title: Approximate shape model
controls.summary: Shape estimated from Voyager images. Its outline is measured, but local terrain is unresolved; gray grid: no imagery.
